name: Locus Mine Support
description: Supports attack skills that use bows or wands and fire projectiles ahead. Instead of using that skill, you will throw mines that will use the skill for you when you detonate them, targeting your location. Mines cannot use channelling skills.

stats: Supported Skills throw up to 2 additional Mines
Mine lasts 5 seconds
Mines from Supported Skills can't be Detonated while within 3 metres of you
Supported Skills have a Base Mine Detonation Time of 0.25 seconds
Supported Skills fire 30% less Projectiles
Supported Skills throw Mines in an Arc
Mines using Supported Skills always target your location
Supported Attack Skills cannot be used with Melee Weapons
